component.name: TakeoutFM
component.summary: Music, radio, podcasts, movies and TV from your Takeout server

description.p: TakeoutFM plays the music, radio, podcasts, movies and TV on your own Takeout media server.

ul.li: Browse artists, albums, playlists, radio stations, podcasts, movies and TV
Gapless music playback, with Plasma's media controls and keys
Movies and episodes resume where you left them, on any of your devices
Download music, podcasts and video to play offline
